building: logging clearing south of the Carpenter
where_text: the logging clearing of old stumps on the slope south of the New Haven Carpenter, at the south-west edge of town
notes: Real willow (0x0CE6) at 3432,2661,43; old stumps at 3432-3441,2653-2663 show trees were felled here. Arm on the east side of the willow. No building: the carpenter's shop is 15 tiles north. On a slope (Z 36-45), no road; the sign stands at the clearing's north-east edge.

where_text: the end of the west pier, New Haven Docks
notes: Arm on the pier planks at the south end (stand Z 1), with open sea (land water, Z -5) on the tile south (3504,2617). Fisherman spawner 3504,2612; small fish lie on the planks at 3502-3505,2614-2615. Sign on the pier near its head.

where_text: the grass beside the north road out of town, below the hill road to the necromancers' temple
notes: Open grass slope east of the dirt road (road x 3503-3506). Props: campfire (P1) and wild garlic patch (P2), each at stand Z 25 because of the slope. No building. Medium-low: a roadside spot.

where_text: George Hephaestus's Forge and Anvil, the fenced smithy yard west of the scribe's, street side
notes: Fixtures are the release's ClusterFNewHavenServicesSeeder decoration (ServUO NewHaven.cfg and haven.cfg lines): AnvilEast 3467,2540,36; Forges 3467,2539 and 3467,2541 (Z 36); AnvilSouth 3468,2535 and 3470,2535 and SmallForge 3469,2535 on the upper step (Z 41); large forge statics 3474-3477,2538,31 in the room east. Map statics: iron ore, ore cart, smith's hammer, tables. Yard opens south onto the cobbles at 3467-3470,2543 (no door). Blacksmith spawner 3470,2539, smith guildmaster 3469,2536. Alternative with map-static forge and anvil: the Warrior's Guild yard, 3523-3525,2535-2539 (Z 20).

where_text: the New Haven Tailor, the north workroom, west side of the square
notes: Real fixtures: loom (seeder statics 0x1061/0x1062) 3498-3499,2546,20; loom bench 3494,2546; spinning wheel 3499,2553 in the south room; bolts of cloth, folded and cut cloth on the tables. Doors: the south door 3497,2556 (DarkWoodDoor) is the shop door under the hanging sign 3498,2557; the west door 3491,2547 opens onto the square. Upstairs (Z 40) is an elven home with an elven alchemy table.

where_text: the New Haven Carpenter, the workshop at the south-west edge of town
notes: Real fixtures: woodworker's benches 3439,2635 and 3439,2639; saw, lathe work, moulding board, inshave and hammer on them; logs 3442-3444,2632; boards on the table 3442-3443,2634-2636; desk with a map and pen and ink 3441,2644-2645. Door: the east opening at 3448,2636-2637, up a wooden ramp from Z 22.

where_text: Springs N Things, the tinker's shop north of the smithy (Amelia Youngstone's)
notes: Real fixtures: worktables with clock parts, springs, a lever and a clock frame 3455,2527-2529; a clock on the bench 3459,2527; axles, gears, hinges and sextant parts on the tables in the north room 3455-3462,2523-2524. Door: south 3458,2531 (DarkWoodDoor). The hanging sign is at 3459,2532. Tinker spawners 3458,2524 and 3458,2528.

where_text: the New Haven Alchemist, the shop of bottles by the healer's
notes: Display cases full of bottles 3457,2563-2565; bookcases 3460-3461,2563; Alchemist and Herbalist spawners 3461,2566. There is no alchemy table here: the only elven alchemy table is upstairs in the tailor's elven home (3499,2546,40), so the lesson's own props (mortar table, cauldron) go on P1. Door: west 3456,2567 (LightWoodDoor, Z 32, up wooden stairs from the lane).

where_text: the bowyers' corner of the Warrior's Guild yard (Andric and Kashiel, New Haven Bowyer)
notes: Real fixture: archery butte static 3538,2529,20; crossbow bolts 3537,2530; the bowyers stand at 3535,2536 and 3538,2536. Open dirt yard inside the guild walls. The yard is the Warrior Guild yard that combat.weapons uses (target 3531,2541), so keep clear of 3529,2544 and 3531,2541. Entry gate north 3525-3526,2527.

where_text: the Baker's shop, the bakery next to the alchemist
notes: Real fixtures: kettle on the counter 3464-3465,2573; open sack of flour 3466,2574 and sacks 3461,2573; flour sifter, pies, cake, French bread, muffins and eggs on the tables 3460-3466,2576-2580. The chimney (3460,2574-2575, Z 65) marks the west-wall hearth, but there is no oven or hearth static on the floor, so the lesson's oven or hearth prop goes on P1 (against the west wall). Door: east 3468,2577. Hanging sign 3469,2574. Baker spawner 3463,2576.

where_text: the scribe's library room, the stone house north of the smithy (New Haven Scribe)
notes: Real fixtures: elven reading desks 3468,2526 and 3475,2526; bookstands 3467,2527 and 3474,2526; a row of bookcases along 2526; globe 3470,2528. The scribe's counter room with display cases is at 3466-3468,2517-2521. Door: east 3477,2527 (DarkWoodDoor). Hanging sign 3478,2528. Scribe spawner 3471,2528.

where_text: the New Haven Mapmaker, the little shop above the docks (shipwright and mapmaker)
notes: Real fixtures: globe 3494,2588; sextant on the table 3492-3493,2591; elven wall map 3493,2588. Door: east 3496,2589 (Z 35) onto a landing; a wooden ramp runs down south to the dock at 3500,2593. The sign stands on the dock by the ramp foot. Hanging sign 3497,2594. Shipwright spawner 3495,2590.

building: back alley by the fighting pit
where_text: the back alley behind the tavern, by the fighting pit, where New Haven's thief lurks
notes: New Haven has no thieves' guild. The Thief spawner is at 3450,2569 in this cobbled lane (x 3449-3456) between the tavern's fighting pit and the healer's and alchemist's back doors; garbage and hay lie about. Arm in the lane, props for a mark or chest. Not a building: low-medium.

where_text: the ankh shrine in the garden east of the cottage on the south lane, with benches facing it
notes: Real fixture: ankh statics (0x2/0x3, the north-facing ankh) 3464,2600-2601 on stone steps (top Z 27); wooden benches 3466,2599-2601 face it; a statue 3466,2607 and poppies. Garden at ground Z 12-13, open air. There is no chapel; this is the town's shrine. The release seeder also places an AnkhNorth at 3526,2516,25, north of the Warrior's Guild.

building: New Haven Mage hall, crystal-ball room
where_text: the New Haven Mage hall, the north room with the crystal ball (Z 52)
notes: The instructor stands behind the crystal-ball table (3484-3486,2492; crystal ball 3485,2492,55) between the big elven chairs, facing south. The trainee arms 3 tiles south of her, and the echo is 2 tiles from the arm. None of these is the magery tiles 3486,2501 / 3484,2497 or the demo spot 3488,2500. The way in is the south door 3485-3486,2503 (MetalDoor) into the south hall, then the doorway 3485,2496. The west half of the building is the upper library at Z 71.

where_text: the Necromancers' Guild Hall, the black stone temple on the hill north-east of town (Mulcivikh and Morganna's hall)
notes: The arm is in the central hall at Z 15, looking north between the corpse biers (3551-3552 and 3557-3558, 2455-2457). The echo is 3 tiles north of the arm. The keeper stands at the foot of the north stair (3553-3557,2449-2453 rises to the roof terrace of skull poles and bone piles), facing south. Side rooms: a library with bookcases and an elven reading desk (west), bedrooms, and an embalming room with bloody water, tongs and knives (south-east). Door: south MetalDoor 3555,2466 (seeder), with braziers on either side. Mulcivikh's seeded home is 3555,2457 and Morganna's is 3547,2462; none of the lesson tiles uses them.

where_text: the Hamato Dojo, the walled dojo north of town (Hamato)
notes: Real fixtures: sword displays 3492-3496,2411-2415, paper lanterns, goza mats, tatami, a rock garden 3505-3506,2426-2429, bamboo, and sliding doors 3492,2420/2423. Arm in the north hall at Z 55. The compound opens south onto its garden; the sign is south of it. Hamato's seeded spot is 3494,2414.

where_text: the Ninja Dojo, the small dojo at the west edge of town (Ryuichi and Chiyo)
notes: Real fixtures: sword displays 3417,2518 and 3419,2516; paper screens 3421-3422,2522; low table with sushi 3417,2520; fans, lanterns, a stone garden at the south. Arm inside at Z 21; the entrance is the south gap at 3418-3419,2524. Ryuichi and Chiyo stand at 3422,2520 and 3424,2520.
